name: Qwen3.8-35B-A3B (Empero distill)

lineage.how_derived: off-policy SFT on curated teacher traces from Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (internal datasets), weighted to hard math and competitive programming

purpose: Bring frontier-teacher reasoning behaviour into a sparse 35B-A3B that runs on one GPU (card).
